children: Eurozone government bond yields fall in early trade, tracking U.S. Treasury yields lower, helped by declining oil prices. "Bond markets have reached a critical point. The coming days will show whether the market can stabilize again following initial signs of shifting dynamics," Commerzbank's Rainer Guntermann says in a note. The 10-year German Bund yield falls 5.9 basis points to 3.472%, while the 10-year French OAT yield slides 9.3 basis points to 4.487%, according to Tradeweb. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
